fix.notes: The `display_date_title` attribute will render as an empty string in templates where it hasn't been set (Mustache silently omits missing keys), so templates that render a `display_date` without a corresponding Python-side `display_date_title` will simply show no tooltip rather than erroring. The `data/person.py:328` path that also sets `n.display_date` for player notes was left unchanged since `views/player_notes.py` overwrites it anyway.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Relative date strings like "3 days ago" or "2 weeks ago" appeared throughout the site (deck pages, match tables, competitions, news, player notes) with no way for users to see the exact underlying datetime on hover.

## What changed

- **`shared/dtutil.py`**: Added `exact_date(dt)` function returning the datetime formatted as `'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'` in the WotC (Pacific) timezone.
- **`decksite/prepare.py`**: Set `display_date_title` alongside `display_date` for both decks (`d.active_date`) and matches (`m.date`).
- **`decksite/view.py`**: Set `display_date_title` for competitions (`c.start_date`).
- **`decksite/data/news.py`**: Set `display_date_title` for news items (`item.date`).
- **`decksite/views/player_notes.py`**: Set `display_date_title` for player notes (`n.created_date`).
- **7 Mustache templates** (`deckmatches.mustache`, `personmatches.mustache`, `deckrow.mustache`, `competitions.mustache`, `news.mustache`, `playernotes.mustache`, `subtitle.mustache`): Wrapped or annotated the `{{display_date}}` output with a `title="{{display_date_title}}"` attribute so browsers show the exact date on hover.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (exit 0)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected (MariaDB bootstrapped in the cloud environment per sweep instructions)

Fixes #8101
fix.pr_title: Add exact date tooltips to display dates (#8101)

evidence.detail: Date cell is {{display_date}} — no title attribute with exact date
Same pattern: {{display_date}} rendered without a title attribute
display_date() returns only relative text ('3 days ago', 'Jan 3rd') with no exact ISO date; no companion exact-date function exists
prepare_decks sets d.display_date and d.date_sort but no d.display_date_title
prepare_matches sets m.display_date and m.date_sort but no m.display_date_title

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Add exact_date(dt) to shared/dtutil.py returning e.g. dt.astimezone(WOTC_TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'). 2) In decksite/prepare.py, set d.display_date_title = dtutil.exact_date(d.active_date) for decks and m.display_date_title = dtutil.exact_date(m.date) for matches. 3) Wrap {{display_date}} in a <span title="{{display_date_title}}"> in the affected templates: deckmatches.mustache, personmatches.mustache, deckrow.mustache, competitions.mustache, news.mustache, playernotes.mustache, subtitle.mustache.
triage.notes: The pattern of using title attributes is already established in prepare.py for top8_safe and stars_safe; this follows the same convention. No schema changes, no data-retention implications.
